name: magazin-pos
description: Профессионалдуу азык-түлүк дүкөнү үчүн POS системасы

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix shared && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix electron
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.start:all: npm run docker:up && npm run db:setup && npm run dev
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:push && npm run db:seed
scripts.dev:desktop: concurrently -n backend,frontend,electron -c blue,green,yellow "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npm run dev --prefix electron"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix shared && npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build && npm run build --prefix electron
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix shared && npm run test --prefix backend
